changes.text: HT-Bench: about 10M egocentric RGB and 7.8M full-hand tactile frames over 226 tasks, extending OpenTouch and EgoTouch with new recordings from an unnamed glove; release of data and weights announced, no link yet.

TouchBench: 900 egocentric clips (75 min, 5 people, 11 tasks) with a right-hand glove of 132 pressure taxels and 5 flexion channels at about 98 Hz, probing fill level, tightness and other hidden properties; no release stated.
CoP: Center-of-Pressure touch from XELA uSkin on a 16-DoF Allegro hand for blind sim-to-real RL; 0.78 peg-in-hole success zero-shot against 0.48 for raw taxels; no code release.

TacForcing: streaming action expert that refreshes Sharpa Wave fingertip touch after every executed block, with FTP-1's tactile encoder; 66% average real success on six tasks against 51% for FTP-1 and T-Rex; no code release.
3DTouch: pi0-based VLA placing 600 XHand three-axis taxels and an RGB-D cloud in one 3D frame; 65.0% average success on five real tasks against 45.0% for Tactile-VLA; no code release.

Contact-Grounded Policy (RSS 2026): diffusion policy forecasting robot state and Digit360 tactile latents on an Allegro V5 hand; 93.3% jar opening against 66.7% for a visuotactile diffusion policy; no code release.
Dex-X (CoRL 2026): visual-tactile policy learned from human videos in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a Sharpa Wave hand with fingertip force, 28/30 cube picks; MIT-licensed code public.
Tac2Pix: projects 44 LEAP Hand tactile nodes into image-space saliency for pretrained visual encoders; 51.7% real success under occlusion against 25.0% for cross-attention; code announced.
HandTouch: vector-quantised vision-tactile encoder trained on HT-Bench full-hand touch; Recall@5 85.23% against 74.65% for a ViT encoder; code and weights announced.

TMA: sim-trained humanoid doorknob policy on a BrainCo Revo2 hand that adapts from capacitive fingertip force history; 27 of 40 real doors opened against 6 for a reactive tactile policy; no code release.
